# Modern Healthcare: Marc D. Miller on the Role of Behavioral Health in Whole-Person Care


Marc_D_Miller-11-24_700


**November 2026** — In a recent *Modern Healthcare* article, UHS President and CEO Marc D. Miller shares his perspective on why hospital and health system leaders should view behavioral healthcare as an essential component of whole-person care. He explores how integrating mental health services into the broader patient journey can help health systems address unmet needs, improve access and potentially reduce avoidable emergency department utilization.


The conversation underscores the importance of breaking down barriers between physical health and mental health, creating stronger coordinated services across care settings, and making it easier for patients to access the right level of support when they need it. As Miller emphasizes, **“Behavioral health is no longer a separate conversation from physical health. It’s a core part of caring for the whole person.”**


[Read the full article in Modern Healthcare >](https://www.modernhealthcare.com/content-studio/executive-conversation/mh-building-a-connected-continuum-for-behavioral-healthcare/)
